use_cases: Displaying testimonial or review cards with scroll-triggered stacking animations
Creating interactive feature showcases with parallax card effects
Building portfolio or project galleries with depth-based card transformations
Designing product carousels with scroll-driven reveal animations
Crafting visual storytelling sections with animated card sequences
ai_summary: A scroll-driven animated card stack component featuring glass-morphism styling with backdrop blur effects and dark/light theme variants. Cards animate in 3D space with transform, rotation, and stacking effects based on scroll progress using Framer Motion. Designed for showcasing testimonials, features, or product cards with engaging visual hierarchy and smooth motion.
